path.description: Run-relative artifact path; fetch it through the run artifact route.

state.description: complete: every record of the run's event log up to the source high-water mark was readable; partial: at least one record before the run's terminal could not be read, so a final may be missing.

count.description: Number of final-message records after the header line.

bytes.description: Exact size of the served document, header and final LF included.

sha256.description: sha256 of exactly the served bytes, written sha256:<hex>.

throughEventSeq.description: Inclusive seq of the last readable run event read before the run's first terminal; 0 when the checked log held no readable event.

anyOf.description: Address and exact size and digest of a run's saved final-messages document.

reason.description: source_unreadable: the run's event log had no readable event when its terminal was prepared; publication_failed: the document could not be saved; artifact_unavailable: the saved document cannot be read with its recorded size and digest.

anyOf.description: A run's final messages that no confirmed document holds, with the typed reason.

FinalMessagesOutcome.description: The saved final-message document's address or a typed gap. An explicit result read returns null when the outcome is unknown, including older runs and runs awaiting their terminal.
